title: Model cohort hypothesis bank & recon playbook for competitive positioning
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Goal: Create a reusable hypothesis bank that segments the model landscape into operational cohorts (e.g., low-latency edge candidates, quantized throughput champions, high-context generative leaders) and an associated recon playbook teams can use to evaluate emergent providers. Deliverables: 1) taxonomy of cohorts with crisp inclusion criteria and trade-offs, 2) a templated recon checklist with measurements (latency p50/p99, cold-start, token cost estimates, quantization fidelity), 3) scripts/queries and dashboards for continuous signal capture, 4) prioritization rules mapping cohorts to product-led GTM and Dedicated/Private readiness. This ticket ties together competitive analysis, model scouting, and market research outputs so PMs and SEs can quickly decide whether to onboard, benchmark, or ignore a model variant.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort taxonomy document published in Confluence with 6+ example models mapped
Recon playbook with step-by-step measurement checklist and required test workloads
Dashboard prototype (Grafana/Looker) with daily signal ingestion showing latency and availability trends
Prioritization rubric that maps cohorts to product impact and provisioning recommendation (Host vs Dedicated vs Private)
Runbook for SRE/Bench team to onboard a new model to the continuous scout pipeline
